prompts.title: YouTube Video Script Writer
prompts.usage: Paste into ChatGPT or Claude — replace [TOPIC] with your video idea
prompts.prompt:
You are a professional YouTube scriptwriter. Write a complete, engaging script for a YouTube video about [TOPIC]. Include:
- A strong hook in the first 30 seconds
- 3-5 main sections with clear transitions
- A compelling call-to-action at the end
- Estimated speaking time for each section
Tone: conversational, energetic, and educational. Target audience: Pakistani digital entrepreneurs aged 18-35.

prompts.title: Viral TikTok Caption Generator
prompts.usage: Add your video description and let AI generate 5 caption options
prompts.prompt:
Generate 5 viral TikTok captions for a video about [VIDEO DESCRIPTION]. Each caption should:
- Start with a hook that stops the scroll
- Be under 150 characters
- Include 5-7 relevant hashtags
- Have a question or CTA to boost comments
Make them punchy, relatable, and shareable for a Pakistani audience.

prompts.title: Product Description for E-Commerce
prompts.usage: Replace [PRODUCT] and [KEY FEATURES] with your product details
prompts.prompt:
Write a high-converting product description for [PRODUCT]. Key features: [KEY FEATURES]. Include:
- An attention-grabbing headline
- 3-4 benefit-focused bullet points (not just features)
- A short story or use case
- A clear call-to-action
- SEO keywords naturally woven in
Tone: persuasive but trustworthy. Keep it under 200 words.

prompts.title: Freelancer Proposal Template
prompts.usage: Fill in your skills and the client project details
prompts.prompt:
Write a professional Upwork/Fiverr proposal for [CLIENT PROJECT]. My skills: [YOUR SKILLS]. The proposal should:
- Open with the client's problem (not 'I am a designer with 5 years experience')
- Show I understand their specific needs
- Offer a clear, results-focused solution
- Include a brief relevant experience or result
- End with a confident but soft CTA
Keep it under 200 words. Sound human, confident, and client-focused.

prompts.title: Instagram Bio Optimizer
prompts.usage: Replace placeholders with your actual info and niche
prompts.prompt:
Write 3 different professional Instagram bios for a [NICHE] creator/business. Each bio should:
- Be under 150 characters
- Clearly state who I help and what I do
- Include a unique value proposition
- End with a call-to-action (link in bio, DM, etc.)
- Use 1-2 relevant emojis
My target audience: [TARGET AUDIENCE]. My main service/content: [WHAT YOU DO].

prompts.title: Email Marketing Campaign
prompts.usage: Best for course launches, promotions, and lead nurturing
prompts.prompt: Write a 3-email welcome sequence for new subscribers who signed up for [LEAD MAGNET/FREEBIE]. Email 1 (Deliver + Introduce): deliver the promised resource and introduce myself. Email 2 (Value): share my best tip related to [TOPIC] — no selling. Email 3 (Offer): introduce my paid course/service [PRODUCT NAME] with a special offer. Tone: friendly, personal, conversational. Each email: subject line + preview text + body (under 300 words).

prompts.title: SEO Blog Article Outline
prompts.usage: Great for ranking on Google and generating passive traffic
prompts.prompt:
Create a detailed SEO-optimized blog post outline for the keyword '[TARGET KEYWORD]'. Include:
- An H1 title with the keyword
- Meta description (under 160 characters)
- 5-7 H2 sections with H3 subsections
- Key points to cover in each section
- Internal linking suggestions
- FAQ section with 3-4 questions
- Word count recommendation
Target audience: [AUDIENCE]. Search intent: [INFORMATIONAL/COMMERCIAL/TRANSACTIONAL].

prompts.title: Business Plan in 5 Minutes
prompts.usage: Quick business plan for pitching or personal clarity
prompts.prompt:
Create a 1-page business plan for my [BUSINESS IDEA]. Include:
- Business name and tagline
- Problem it solves
- Target customer (specific)
- Solution / Product description
- Revenue model (how I make money)
- 3 key marketing channels
- 90-day action plan with 5 milestones
- Startup cost estimate
Make it practical, not theoretical. I am based in Pakistan and targeting [LOCAL/INTERNATIONAL] customers.
